questions.stem: In 1890, there lived a person who had hypersexuality disorder, raped almost 60 women in his lifetime but was never caught. In his 61st rape attempt, he was caught and taken to court. The first punishment ordered by the court was sterilization. What is the kind of sterilization done in this man?
